aside.p1: Each lead goes to at most 3 sellers, never a crowd.
aside.p2: You see the buyer's intent score and your rank before you spend a credit.
aside.p3: Buyer unreachable or fake? The credit comes back within 72 hours, no ticket needed.
aside.p4: Free plan. Public pricing. Your badge never depends on what you pay.

signup.title: Start selling, free
